name: Button Beetle
script:
on tick every 8:
  if rand(10) < 2 then walk to garden; frame 2 else frame 1 end
end
on poke: say 1; hop 8; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, shiny) then seek shiny; say 2 end
end

name: Lantern Moth
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on tick every 20:
  if rand(4) == 0 then float end
end
on poke: say 1; emit sparkle; end

name: Teacup Stool
script:
on poke: say 1; emit puff; end
on near moss:
  if rand(3) == 0 then emit heart end
end
on weather rainy: sound plop; emit puff; end

name: Driftglass Chime
script:
on world breeze: sound ding; frame 2; wait 4; frame 3; say 1; end
on tick every 40:
  if rand(5) == 0 then frame 2; sound ding; wait 2; frame 1 end
end
on poke: sound tune; emit note; say 2; end

name: Mossy Pebble
script:
on weather rainy: frame 2; emit puff; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on bumped: say 1; hop 4; end
on tick every 120:
  if rand(6) == 0 then emit zzz end
end

name: Clockwork Mouse
script:
on tick every 12:
  mem[0] -= 1
  if mem[0] > 0 then walk to anywhere; frame 2 else stop; frame 1 end
end
on poke: mem[0] = 20; sound clock; say 1; end
on hour: if hour == 12 then say 2; mem[0] = 10 end; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, clockwork) then say 3 end
end

name: Sugar Fern
script:
on berry: frame 2; end
on tick every 60:
  if berries > 3 then frame 3; emit sparkle else frame 1 end
end
on poke: say 1; emit heart; end

name: Grumpy Kettle
script:
on hour:
  if hour == 16 then frame 2; sound fizz; burst puff; say 1; wait 12; frame 1 end
end
on poke: say 2; emit puff; end
on weather snowy: glow on; end
on weather sunny: glow off; end

name: Dandelion Wisp
script:
on world breeze: float; burst puff; frame 2; end
on tick every 30:
  if rand(6) == 0 then emit puff end
end
on poke: float; say 1; end

name: Woolly Ladybird
script:
on berry: walk to garden; frame 2; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, food) then eat; emit heart end
end
on poke: say 1; hop; end
on time night: stop; frame 1; say 2; emit zzz; end

name: Ghost Sock
script:
on time night: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on world dark: sound whoosh; say 1; end
on poke:
  if time == night then say 2 else emit puff end
end

name: Barnacle Clock
script:
on hour:
  frame 1 + hour % 2; sound clock
  if hour == 12 then say 1; burst note; signal 7 end
end
on poke: sound clock; emit note; end

name: Pebble Golem
script:
on time night: stop; frame 2; emit zzz; end
on time day: frame 1; walk to works; end
on poke: say 1; shake; end
on jam jammed: walk to works; say 2; end

name: Accordion Frog
script:
on tick every 16:
  if playing == 1 and rand(3) == 0 then hop 10; emit note end
end
on poke: sound tune; frame 2; say 1; end
on weather rainy: walk to water; sound splash; hop; say 2; end

name: Brass Telescope
script:
on time night: frame 2; say 1; emit sparkle; end
on time day: frame 1; end
on poke: face; say 2; end
on world visitor: frame 2; say 3; end

name: Honey Pot
script:
on near critter: say 1; emit heart; end
on world ants: sound crunch; say 2; end
on tick every 80:
  if rand(10) == 0 then emit sparkle end
end

name: Paper Lantern
script:
on time dusk: glow on; end
on time dawn: glow off; end
on world dark: glow on; say 1; end
on signal 7: glow toggle; emit sparkle; end
on poke: glow toggle; end

name: Puddle Duckling
script:
on weather rainy: walk to water; say 1; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wet) then hop; sound splash end
end
on poke: sound chirp; frame 2; say 2; end

name: Prickle Pal
script:
on weather sunny: frame 2; say 1; end
on weather rainy: frame 1; say 2; end
on poke: hop 3; emit heart; end
on bumped: sound pop; emit puff; end

name: Cheer Flag
script:
on jam jammed: say 1; frame 2; end
on jam fixed: frame 1; burst sparkle; end
on tick every 40:
  if sulking == 1 then nudge; say 2 end
end

name: Bubble Jelly
script:
on tick every 10:
  if rand(8) == 0 then emit puff end
end
on poke: float; sound plop; say 1; end
on world leak: frame 2; say 2; end

name: Knitted Armchair
script:
on time night: emit zzz; say 1; end
on near moss: emit heart; end
on new:
  if has(newtraits, cosy) then say 2; emit heart else emit puff end
end

name: Firefly Jar
script:
on tick every 6:
  if time == night and rand(4) == 0 then emit sparkle; frame 2 end
end
on time day: frame 1; end
on poke: burst sparkle; say 1; end

name: Toadstool Lamp
script:
on time dusk: glow on; end
on time dawn: glow off; end
on world bloom: burst sparkle; frame 2; say 1; end
on poke: glow toggle; end

name: Grumbling Beetle
script:
on bumped: say 1; hop 12; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, fragile) then stop; say 2 end
end
on tick every 20:
  if rand(5) == 0 then walk to anywhere; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end

name: Biscuit Tin
script:
on poke: frame 2; say 1; wait 8; frame 1; end
on gift: say 2; emit heart; end
on world visitor: frame 2; emit sparkle; end

name: Cuckoo Box
script:
on hour:
  if hour % 3 == 0 then frame 2; sound chirp; say 1; wait 4; frame 1 end
end
on poke: sound chirp; say 2; end

name: Moss Kite
script:
on world breeze: float; burst sparkle; say 1; end
on weather stormy: frame 2; say 2; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on poke: float; end

name: Toadstool Stool
script:
on poke: hop 4; emit puff; end
on weather rainy: frame 2; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on near critter: say 1; end

name: Hungry Hedgehog
script:
on berry: walk to garden; say 1; end
on tick every 24:
  if berries > 0 and rand(3) == 0 then eat end
end
on poke:
  if fed > 5 then say 2; emit heart else hop end
end
on time night: frame 2; emit zzz; end

name: Snow Globe
script:
on poke: burst sparkle; say 1; end
on weather snowy: frame 2; say 2; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on bumped: say 3; end

name: Busy Bee
script:
on tick every 16:
  if rand(4) == 0 then seek plant; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, plant) then drop; emit heart end
end
on poke: sound fizz; say 1; end

name: Foghorn Shell
script:
on hour:
  if hour == 18 then sound horn; say 1 end
end
on weather foggy: sound horn; say 2; end
on poke: sound splash; emit note; end

name: Pocket Watch
script:
on tick every 4:
  mem[0] += 1
  frame 1 + mem[0] % 4
end
on poke: sound clock; say 1; end

name: Lily Pad
script:
on weather rainy: frame 2; emit heart; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; end
on near snail: say 1; end
on poke: sound splash; emit puff; end

name: Coin Crab
script:
on shipped: sound coin; hop; say 1; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, shiny) then seek shiny; say 2 end
end
on tick every 30:
  if rand(4) == 0 then walk to dock; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end

name: Twig Hammock
script:
on time night: frame 2; emit zzz; end
on time day: frame 1; end
on world breeze: frame 3; wait 8; frame 1; end
on poke: say 1; emit zzz; end

name: Spore Puffball
script:
on bumped: burst puff; sound pop; end
on world bloom: frame 2; burst puff; say 1; end
on poke: emit puff; say 2; end

name: Brass Fan
script:
on jam jammed: frame 2; say 1; end
on jam fixed: frame 1; end
on poke: boost 10; sound whoosh; say 2; end

name: Starlight Mobile
script:
on time night: glow on; burst sparkle; end
on time dawn: glow off; end
on tick every 40:
  if rand(3) == 0 then frame 1 + rand(3) end
end
on poke: say 1; emit zzz; end
